report_name: CISA Adds Actively Exploited Drupal, Optimizely, and AntiCsrf Flaws to KEV

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Threat actors are actively exploiting vulnerabilities in public-facing applications, including Drupal Core (CVE-2026-132165), Idunno.AntiCsrf (CVE-2026-131914), and Optimizely Web Experimentation (CVE-2026-132224), to achieve remote code execution and system compromise.

attack_patterns.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: The active exploitation of vulnerabilities in Drupal, Idunno.AntiCsrf, and Optimizely constitutes exploitation of remote services, as these are web-facing applications accessible over the network.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-132165
vulnerabilities.description: A remote code execution vulnerability in Drupal Core that allows an unauthenticated attacker to potentially reinstall a site by abusing the install.php script, leading to a complete site takeover. The vulnerability is under active exploitation.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-131914
vulnerabilities.description: A critical deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the Idunno.AntiCsrf component for ASP.NET, allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution via a specially crafted serialized payload. The vulnerability is under active exploitation.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-132224
vulnerabilities.description: An external control of critical state data vulnerability in Optimizely Web Experimentation. Its inclusion in the CISA KEV catalog confirms it is being actively exploited to compromise systems.

identities.name: Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies
identities.description: A class of U.S. federal agencies mandated by CISA to remediate the actively exploited vulnerabilities by a strict deadline.

indicators.name: Suspicious Drupal Installer Access
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Drupal Installer Access
id: d1e2f3a4-b5c6-4d7e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Detects web requests to the Drupal installer script (install.php). Access to this file on a production server is highly suspicious and may indicate an attempt to exploit CVE-2026-132165.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/11/24/cisa-adds-three-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-25
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.initial_access
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|endswith: '/install.php'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web server access log entries for requests to `install.php`, which is a key indicator for attempts to exploit CVE-2026-132165 in Drupal.

indicators.name: Suspicious Web Server Child Process
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Web Server Child Process
id: a3b4c5d6-e7f8-4a9b-8c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects a web server process spawning a suspicious child process like a shell or PowerShell, which may indicate remote code execution via a web vulnerability such as CVE-2026-132165 or CVE-2026-131914.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/11/24/cisa-adds-three-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-25
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
      - '\apache2.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects web server processes (e.g., w3wp.exe, httpd) spawning shells, a common post-exploitation behavior for RCE vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-132165 and CVE-2026-131914.
